title: Display official contact email across the platform

requirements.text: Display 'pristinelearningofficial@gmail.com' as the official contact email in the site footer, About/Contact sections, and any support reference areas across the platform. Render it as a clickable 'mailto:pristinelearningofficial@gmail.com' link wherever it appears.

quotes: can you set the official email Id as pristinelearningofficial@gmail.com
Display pristinelearningofficial@gmail.com as the official contact email in the footer, About/Contact sections, and support references as a mailto: link

acceptanceCriteria: The email 'pristinelearningofficial@gmail.com' appears in the site footer as a clickable mailto: link.
Any About or Contact section on the homepage or other public pages shows the email as a mailto: link.
Any support or help references in dashboards or other pages that mention contact information display this email as a mailto: link.
Clicking the email link opens the user's default mail client addressed to pristinelearningofficial@gmail.com.

constraints: No email sending functionality — display only as a mailto: hyperlink.
Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Implementing a contact form that sends emails.
Integrating any SMTP or email delivery service.
Changing any backend logic or data models.
